# Louiss Web Studio

> Web design and development studio based in Tangier, Morocco, building fast, conversion-focused websites for local and regional businesses.

## Services
- Professional showcase (vitrine) website
- E-commerce website
- Landing pages for ad campaigns
- Redesign of an existing website
- Custom full-stack development (Next.js, headless CMS, multilingual sites)

## Notable projects
- [Adventure Keys](https://www.louisswebstudio.com/adventure-keys) — website redesign for a travel agency, built to turn visitors into bookings
- [Maison Monchef](https://www.louisswebstudio.com/maison-monchef) — multilingual (French, English, Arabic) real estate platform for a Dubai-based client, built with Next.js and Sanity CMS
- [El Majdoub Immobilier](https://www.louisswebstudio.com/el-majdoub) — real estate rental platform connecting owners and qualified tenants in Agadir
- [Digiseo](https://www.louisswebstudio.com/digiseo) — website redesign for an SEO and digital marketing agency
